January 9, 2026 - Born on Titan to Mentor and Sui-San, Thanos murdered his own mother as a child and began an unhealthy, fruitless pursuit of winning Mistress Death's love.[30][31] To appease his mistress, the power-hungry, genocidal Mad Titan indiscriminately murdered countless lives and sought higher powers, such as the Cosmic Cube and the Infinity Gems.[32][33] Infamously, he once eradicated half of the universe's population and usurped its cosmic beings with the Infinity Gauntlet.[34] Thanos has come into conflict with the Marvel Universe on several occasions, but he developed a closeness with his sometimes enemy, sometimes ally Adam Warlock.[35][36][37][38][39][40][41]
